question: Tensile or compressive stress can also be termed as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**longitudinal stress.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tensile stress** refers to the **stretching of a material**, while **compressive stress** refers to the **squeezing or pressing **of a material.
 
• Longitudinal stress
